scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mercado/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @mercado/backend" "npm run dev -w @mercado/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mercado/shared && npm run build -w @mercado/frontend && npm run build -w @mercado/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @mercado/shared && npm run typecheck -w @mercado/backend && npm run typecheck -w @mercado/frontend && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w @mercado/shared && npm run test -w @mercado/shared && npm run test -w @mercado/backend && npm run test -w @mercado/frontend
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
